title: BenchmarkDefinitionValidator
responsibility: Validates versioned benchmark definitions and rejects duplicate paths, checks and candidates.

inputs.name: BenchmarkDefinitionValidator.validate.input
inputs.description: The raw, untrusted value passed to validate(), typed unknown because it has no static shape guarantee. It must parse under benchmarkDefinitionSchema (version 1, no unknown keys, at least one allowedFiles path, check and candidate), and only a value that parses reaches the duplicate checks.

examples.name: csv-quoted-newlines
examples.task: Make the CSV parser accept quoted fields that contain newlines.
examples.contract: Existing parser tests still pass and the new quoted-newline fixture parses into the expected rows.

examples.name: importer-null-handling
examples.task: Treat empty CSV cells as null instead of empty strings in the typed importer.
examples.contract: Null cells survive a parse-and-serialize round trip and the migration fixtures show no unexpected diffs.

candidates.instructions: Do not change exported type names.

outputs.name: benchmarkDefinitionSchema
outputs.description: The exported zod schema (z.strictObject) that validate() parses its input with, so code outside validate() can apply the same rules. It is strict at every object level, requires version 1, and fills defaults for project ('.'), revision ('HEAD'), setup ([]), candidate instructions (''), candidate tools ('default') and an omitted budget (repetitions 3, timeoutMs 900000, repairs 2).

outputs.name: BenchmarkDefinitionValidator.validate
outputs.description: The normalized definition that validate() returns, which is the exact value benchmarkDefinitionSchema.parse produced, with defaults applied. It is returned only when allowedFiles, the check ids and the candidate ids each have no repeated value, and a value may still repeat across those lists.

examples.name: csv-quoted-newlines
examples.task: Make the CSV parser accept quoted fields that contain newlines.
examples.contract: Existing parser tests still pass and the new quoted-newline fixture parses into the expected rows.

examples.name: importer-null-handling
examples.task: Treat empty CSV cells as null instead of empty strings in the typed importer.
examples.contract: Null cells survive a parse-and-serialize round trip and the migration fixtures show no unexpected diffs.

candidates.instructions: Do not change exported type names.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by validate() as new Error('Duplicate benchmark identifiers or paths.') when allowedFiles, the check ids or the candidate ids repeat a value within their own list, after the schema has accepted the input. Each list is checked only against itself, so the same value can appear in two different lists without error.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Thrown by the zod parse() call inside validate() when the input fails benchmarkDefinitionSchema, for example a non-object, an unknown key, a missing required field, an id or file path that breaks its rule, a budget value out of range, or a codex candidate with tools 'files' or effort 'max'. It is thrown before the duplicate check runs, so a definition that fails the schema never reaches that check.
